steps.content:
Going by the two listings, you can buy from either seller. I couldn't find any difference that matters.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Stock and shipping | In stock, free, 3–5 business days | In stock, free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Specs and box contents | Same, graphite colour | Same, graphite colour |

The two listings match in every detail I could see, including the rating and review count. The reviews may be shared across both listings, so they don't help you choose between the sellers.

Here is how I'd decide:
- **Check the checkout page.** Taxes, shipping options or delivery estimates may differ once you enter your address.
- **Look up each seller's reputation.** Search for independent reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio, and check how long each has been operating. The listings don't show this.
- **Confirm the warranty is honored.** Check whether the warranty comes through the manufacturer or only through the seller.
- **Pick either one if nothing else separates them.** The terms are identical, so the risk is about the same.

If you find a difference, such as a lower price at checkout or a seller with a poor reputation, tell me and I'll help you weigh it.
